sentence: The pharmaceutical tender case runs on compliance with the EU's AI Act and the GDPR
passage: [Pesqueira et al. (2024), p. 1] "This research examines the incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) into the domain of tender management (TM) within the pharmaceutical industry, with a particular emphasis on operational efficiency, governance, and compliance with European regulatory standards." / "The research highlights the necessity of aligning the adoption of AI with the latest European directives, such as the AI Act and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), to ensure both operational efficiency and adherence to ethical standards."

gemini.note: The passage highlights the necessity of aligning AI adoption with the AI Act and GDPR, but does not state that the tender case currently 'runs on' this compliance.
